company.name: BANNER
company.description:
Banner is a company specialised in helping brands succeed in today's complex markets. As a fully integrated agency we provide services across strategy, advertising, offline, digital, demand generation, events and media.

Based in London, England, we create and deliver programmes for some of the world's leading companies throughout Europe, the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

Banner's clients include Lebara Mobile, Crucial, Dell, Autodesk, Trend Micro, Sage, Novell, Pitney Bowes, Corel, Riverbed, Avaya, Symantec, Eloqua, SanDisk, and CA Technologies.
